$comment: PK 2026-10-20 (D157): ព្រះរាជបញ្ជា · Royal Orders — the king's daily orders for whoever is played in the 3D hero mode, like a city sim's daily duties: duties to do (gather, store, defeat, hunt, heal, build, or visit a building) and questions to answer (history and culture). One at a time, picked at random among those for the played hero (kits: empty = everyone), never the same one twice in a row; a duty's count grows by `grow` each time round. PK adds or removes orders in the host dashboard (localhost:7421 → ព្រះរាជបញ្ជា); the bridge writes them to this file and sends them to the game at once. Answers: `answer` is the index of the right option (0 = the first).
